question.text: Under SEBI (PM) Regulations 2020, the discretionary PM must:

answer.text: Pool all clients' securities as a single AUM
Individually and independently manage the funds of each client
Only use one investment approach for all clients

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation requires individual, independent management — not pooling like a MF. The Trap: Pooling would mimic a mutual fund scheme, which is forbidden. Cross-Exam Context: Same rule highlighted in III-A, III-C. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Segregated demat accounts per client are the operational proof of this rule.
